meta.name: 开机词 · 关联词库（示例）
meta.desc: 按词根/场景关联分组的示例词库，可直接替换为自己的词表

groups.title: 词根 spect / spic = 看
groups.hint: 一个词根串起 20 个词：往里看是检查，回头看是尊敬，从下往上看是怀疑。

words.ex: Officials will inspect the factory next week.
words.exCn: 官员下周将视察这家工厂。
words.note: in(向内) + spect(看) → 往里看 = 检查

words.ex: Students respect teachers who listen to them.
words.exCn: 学生尊敬愿意倾听他们的老师。
words.note: re(回) + spect(看) → 回头看 = 尊敬

words.ex: Police suspect the man was lying.
words.exCn: 警方怀疑那名男子在撒谎。
words.note: sus(下) + spect(看) → 从下往上打量 = 怀疑

words.ex: The prospect of a long holiday excited her.
words.exCn: 一想到长假她就很兴奋。
words.note: pro(向前) + spect(看) → 往前看 = 前景

words.ex: Thousands of spectators watched the final.
words.exCn: 数千名观众观看了决赛。

words.ex: The view from the top was spectacular.
words.exCn: 山顶的景色非常壮观。
words.note: spect(看) + acular → 值得一看的

words.ex: Travel gives you a new perspective on life.
words.exCn: 旅行让你对生活有新视角。
words.note: per(贯穿) + spect(看) → 看问题的角度

words.ex: Reporters speculated about the reason for his exit.
words.exCn: 记者们猜测他离职的原因。
words.note: spec(看) + ulate → 反复看 = 推测

words.ex: His red coat made him conspicuous in the crowd.
words.exCn: 他的红外套使他在人群中很显眼。
words.note: con(共同) + spic(看) → 大家都看得见

words.ex: In retrospect, the decision was a mistake.
words.exCn: 回顾起来，那是个错误的决定。

words.ex: We discussed every aspect of the plan.
words.exCn: 我们讨论了计划的每个方面。
words.note: a(向) + spect(看) → 看到的一面

words.ex: We expect the train to arrive at nine.
words.exCn: 我们预计火车九点到。
words.note: ex(向外) + spect(看) → 向外张望 = 期待

words.ex: His visit was completely unexpected.
words.exCn: 他的来访完全出乎意料。

words.ex: The debate covered a wide spectrum of opinions.
words.exCn: 这场辩论涵盖了广泛的观点。
words.note: spect(看) + rum → 看得见的色彩范围

words.ex: The package looked suspicious.
words.exCn: 那个包裹看起来很可疑。
words.note: suspect 的形容词：让人怀疑的

words.ex: She despised dishonesty.
words.exCn: 她鄙视不诚实。
words.note: de(向下) + spic(看) → 往下看 = 看不起

words.ex: A routine inspection found no problems.
words.exCn: 例行检查未发现问题。

words.ex: The fireworks were a magnificent spectacle.
words.exCn: 烟花是壮观的景象。
words.note: spect(看) + acle(物) → 值得看的东西

words.ex: The results exceeded our expectations.
words.exCn: 结果超出了我们的预期。

words.ex: Her suspicion grew when he refused to answer.
words.exCn: 当他拒绝回答时，她的怀疑加深了。

groups.title: 词根 port = 搬运、携带
groups.hint: port 是港口，也是“带”：进口、出口、运输、护照，全是从一个地方带到另一个地方。

words.ex: China imports a large amount of soybeans.
words.exCn: 中国进口大量大豆。
words.note: im(向内) + port(带) → 带进来

words.ex: The country exports coffee to Europe.
words.exCn: 该国向欧洲出口咖啡。
words.note: ex(向外) + port(带) → 带出去

words.ex: Trucks transport goods across the country.
words.exCn: 卡车在全国运输货物。

words.ex: She carries a portable charger in her bag.
words.exCn: 她包里带着一个便携充电器。
words.note: port(带) + able(能) → 能带走的

words.ex: He reported the accident to the police.
words.exCn: 他向警方报告了这起事故。
words.note: re(回) + port(带) → 把消息带回来

words.ex: My family supported my decision.
words.exCn: 家人支持我的决定。
words.note: sup(下) + port(带) → 从下面托住

words.ex: A porter helped us with our luggage.
words.exCn: 一位搬运工帮我们搬行李。

words.ex: She showed her design portfolio at the interview.
words.exCn: 她在面试中展示了设计作品集。
words.note: port(带) + folio(纸页) → 随身带的纸夹

words.ex: The man was deported for overstaying his visa.
words.exCn: 那人因签证过期被驱逐出境。
words.note: de(离开) + port(带) → 把人带走

words.ex: A large proportion of students live on campus.
words.exCn: 很大比例的学生住在校内。
words.note: pro(按) + port(份额) → 按份额分配

words.ex: This job is a great opportunity to learn.
words.exCn: 这份工作是很好的学习机会。
words.note: op(朝向) + port(港口) → 顺风入港的时机

words.ex: Don't forget your passport at the airport.
words.exCn: 在机场别忘了带护照。

words.ex: Sleep is important for memory.
words.exCn: 睡眠对记忆很重要。
words.note: im + port(带) + ant → 有分量的

words.ex: The ship left the port at dawn.
words.exCn: 船在黎明时离开港口。
words.note: 所有 port 词的源头

words.ex: Public transportation in this city is cheap.
words.exCn: 这座城市的公共交通很便宜。

words.ex: He is reportedly moving to Canada.
words.exCn: 据报道他要搬去加拿大。

words.ex: She is a strong supporter of the reform.
words.exCn: 她是这项改革的坚定支持者。

words.ex: The museum bought a portrait by Monet.
words.exCn: 博物馆买下了莫奈的一幅肖像。
words.note: por(向前) + trait(拉) → 拉出人的样子

words.ex: The seaport handles millions of containers.
words.exCn: 这个海港处理数百万集装箱。

words.ex: Her boss was very supportive of her studies.
words.exCn: 她老板非常支持她学习。

groups.title: 词根 dict = 说
groups.hint: dict 是“说”：预先说是预测，反着说是反驳，郑重说是奉献。

words.ex: Experts predict a cold winter.
words.exCn: 专家预测今年冬天会很冷。

words.ex: His actions contradict his words.
words.exCn: 他的行为与言语相矛盾。

words.ex: The teacher dictated a passage to the class.
words.exCn: 老师给全班口述了一段文章。
words.note: dict(说) + ate → 说给别人写

words.ex: Look up the word in a dictionary.
words.exCn: 在词典里查这个词。
words.note: dict(说) + ionary → 收录说法的书

words.ex: The jury reached a verdict after two days.
words.exCn: 陪审团两天后作出裁决。
words.note: ver(真实) + dict(说) → 说出真相

words.ex: She dedicated her life to teaching.
words.exCn: 她把一生奉献给教学。
words.note: de(完全) + dic(说) → 郑重宣告

words.ex: The signs indicate a change in the weather.
words.exCn: 这些迹象表明天气要变。
words.note: in(朝向) + dic(说) → 指给人看

words.ex: He is addicted to video games.
words.exCn: 他沉迷电子游戏。
words.note: ad(朝向) + dict(说) → 被宣告归属

words.ex: There is a contradiction between the two reports.
words.exCn: 两份报告之间存在矛盾。

words.ex: We have an English dictation every Friday.
words.exCn: 我们每周五有英语听写。

words.ex: The king issued an edict banning the practice.
words.exCn: 国王颁布法令禁止这一做法。
words.note: e(向外) + dict(说) → 公开说出

words.ex: The ending of the film was predictable.
words.exCn: 电影结局是可预测的。

words.ex: The weather here is unpredictable.
words.exCn: 这里天气难以预测。

words.ex: The dictator ruled the country for thirty years.
words.exCn: 独裁者统治该国三十年。

words.ex: The king abdicated in favor of his son.
words.exCn: 国王退位让位给儿子。
words.note: ab(离开) + dic(说) → 宣布离开

words.ex: Her dedication to the job impressed everyone.
words.exCn: 她对工作的投入令所有人印象深刻。

words.ex: Unemployment is a key indicator of the economy.
words.exCn: 失业率是经济的关键指标。

words.ex: The witnesses gave contradictory accounts.
words.exCn: 证人给出了相互矛盾的说法。

words.ex: Social media addiction is a growing problem.
words.exCn: 社交媒体成瘾是个日益严重的问题。

words.ex: The actor has clear diction.
words.exCn: 这位演员吐字清晰。
words.note: dict(说) + ion → 说话的方式

groups.title: 场景：求职面试全流程
groups.hint: 按一场面试的时间线记：投简历 → 面试 → 试用 → 转正谈薪。

words.ex: Send your resume before Friday.
words.exCn: 周五前发送你的简历。

words.ex: I applied for a job at a bank.
words.exCn: 我申请了一家银行的工作。
words.note: apply for a job 申请职位

words.ex: Only three candidates passed the test.
words.exCn: 只有三名候选人通过了测试。

words.ex: She has an interview at ten tomorrow.
words.exCn: 她明天十点有面试。

words.ex: The company plans to recruit fifty engineers.
words.exCn: 公司计划招聘五十名工程师。

words.ex: This job requires a teaching qualification.
words.exCn: 这份工作需要教师资格。

words.ex: He asked his professor for a reference.
words.exCn: 他请教授写推荐信。

words.ex: He asked for a higher salary.
words.exCn: 他要求更高的薪水。

words.ex: We negotiated a better price.
words.exCn: 我们谈成了更好的价格。

words.ex: Read the contract carefully before signing.
words.exCn: 签约前仔细阅读合同。

words.ex: New staff have a three-month probation.
words.exCn: 新员工有三个月试用期。

words.ex: My colleagues are friendly and helpful.
words.exCn: 我的同事友好且乐于助人。

words.ex: A good employer values its staff.
words.exCn: 好的雇主重视员工。

words.ex: The company has 200 employees.
words.exCn: 公司有200名员工。

words.ex: She did an internship at a law firm.
words.exCn: 她在律所实习。

words.ex: She got a promotion after two years.
words.exCn: 两年后她获得了晋升。

words.ex: The deadline for applications is May 1.
words.exCn: 申请截止日期是5月1日。

words.ex: There are two vacancies in our team.
words.exCn: 我们团队有两个职位空缺。

words.ex: He works overtime almost every day.
words.exCn: 他几乎每天都加班。

words.ex: Everyone received a year-end bonus.
words.exCn: 每个人都拿到了年终奖。

groups.title: 场景：环境与气候
groups.hint: 从“问题”到“解法”记一组：污染 → 排放 → 保护 → 可持续。

words.ex: Air pollution in the city has fallen since 2015.
words.exCn: 自2015年以来，这座城市的空气污染有所下降。

words.ex: The new rules aim to cut carbon emissions.
words.exCn: 新规旨在减少碳排放。
words.note: e(向外) + miss(送) → 排出去

words.ex: Trees absorb carbon from the air.
words.exCn: 树木从空气中吸收碳。

words.ex: Greenhouse gases trap heat in the atmosphere.
words.exCn: 温室气体在大气中积聚热量。

words.ex: Wind and solar are renewable sources of energy.
words.exCn: 风能和太阳能是可再生能源。

words.ex: They installed solar panels on the roof.
words.exCn: 他们在屋顶安装了太阳能板。

words.ex: The farm uses sustainable methods of growing food.
words.exCn: 这个农场采用可持续的粮食种植方式。

words.ex: She works for a wildlife conservation group.
words.exCn: 她为一个野生动物保护组织工作。

words.ex: Coral reefs support a rich ecosystem.
words.exCn: 珊瑚礁养育着丰富的生态系统。

words.ex: The island is famous for its biodiversity.
words.exCn: 这座岛以生物多样性闻名。

words.ex: Logging destroys the habitat of many birds.
words.exCn: 伐木破坏了许多鸟类的栖息地。

words.ex: The panda was once an endangered species.
words.exCn: 大熊猫曾是濒危物种。

words.ex: The dodo became extinct in the 17th century.
words.exCn: 渡渡鸟在17世纪灭绝。

words.ex: Deforestation is a major cause of flooding.
words.exCn: 森林砍伐是洪水的主要原因。

words.ex: Most of our rubbish ends up in landfill.
words.exCn: 我们的大部分垃圾最终进入垃圾填埋场。

words.ex: Waste from the factory contaminated the river.
words.exCn: 工厂废料污染了这条河。

words.ex: Don't waste water while brushing your teeth.
words.exCn: 刷牙时别浪费水。

words.ex: We recycle paper, glass and plastic at home.
words.exCn: 我们在家回收纸张、玻璃和塑料。

words.ex: The farmers built a simple irrigation system.
words.exCn: 农民建了简易灌溉系统。

words.ex: The drought lasted for three years.
words.exCn: 干旱持续了三年。

groups.title: 场景：情绪与性格
groups.hint: 把情绪排成一条光谱：焦虑 → 紧张 → 沮丧 → 释然；把性格两两配对记。

words.ex: She felt anxious before the exam.
words.exCn: 考试前她感到焦虑。

words.ex: I get nervous before speaking in public.
words.exCn: 公开演讲前我会紧张。
words.note: 比 anxious 更偏“临场紧张”

words.ex: She was frustrated by the slow progress.
words.exCn: 进展缓慢让她很沮丧。

words.ex: A hot bath can relieve stress.
words.exCn: 热水澡可以缓解压力。

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.exCn: 他对未来很乐观。

words.ex: She is confident that she will pass.
words.exCn: 她确信自己能通过。

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.exCn: 我很感激你的帮助。

words.ex: He felt guilty about lying to her.
words.exCn: 他为对她撒谎感到内疚。

words.ex: He was jealous of his brother's success.
words.exCn: 他嫉妒哥哥的成功。
words.note: envy 偏羡慕，jealous 偏吃醋

words.ex: It was generous of you to pay for dinner.
words.exCn: 你付晚餐钱真慷慨。

words.ex: Famous as he is, he remains humble.
words.exCn: 尽管出名，他依然谦逊。

words.ex: He is too stubborn to admit his mistake.
words.exCn: 他太固执，不肯认错。

words.ex: He is sensitive to criticism.
words.exCn: 他对批评很敏感。

words.ex: She is a reliable friend.
words.exCn: 她是个可靠的朋友。

words.ex: The dog becomes aggressive when scared.
words.exCn: 那只狗害怕时会变得有攻击性。

words.ex: Children are naturally curious about the world.
words.exCn: 孩子天生对世界好奇。

words.ex: The kids were enthusiastic about the trip.
words.exCn: 孩子们对这次旅行很热情。

words.ex: Learning a language takes patience.
words.exCn: 学语言需要耐心。

words.ex: Music can change your mood.
words.exCn: 音乐能改变你的心情。
words.note: in a good mood 心情好

words.ex: Good doctors show empathy for patients.
words.exCn: 好医生对病人有同理心。
